limits: Behavior characterization only; it does not prove the PR implementation is correct and is not full PR validation.
S3 module Testcontainers tests were skipped because Docker is unavailable; the S3 probes use a mocked S3Client/S3StorageClient and do not contact a real S3 service.

The S3 completion failure is injected as a synchronous SDK exception from completeMultipartUpload. The probe records the local API-call sequence; it cannot observe the server-side object state. An ambiguous lost completion response and a confirmed incomplete upload are therefore distinguished only by whether complete returned, not by durable server state.
GCS uses the in-memory LocalStorageHelper, not a real GCS service.
Linux aarch64 and Temurin JDK 21.0.12.1+1 only.
No contributor branch was pushed and no PR comment was posted.

overlay.diff: Full diffs are in the evidence archive (overlay.diff); each file is new-only and was deleted before release.

summary: Investigation completed at the exact head with fresh logs and JUnit XML. Both module baselines passed. Two cleanup gaps were reproduced on the PR's new paths: (1) copyIndexFileTo in both S3 and GCS marks success before the destination IndexOutput is closed, so an IndexOutput.close() failure after the body was written leaves the destination file (S3 deleteFile is never called; GCS dest.bin still exists on disk); (2) an S3 multipart completion failure raised from S3OutputStream.close() (and therefore from copyIndexFileFrom's try-with-resources close) is not followed by abort(), leaving the multipart upload initiated and its parts uploaded with neither completion nor abort observable. This is behavior evidence for the investigation, not implementation proof or PR validation.
